assignment: Prepare a case-intake note using only the fictional calendar and rules supplied.
source: Rule A allows ten calendar days after receipt, excluding the receipt day. If the last day is a closure day, filing moves to the next open day. A notice arrived Thursday the 2nd. The 12th is a closed Sunday and the 13th is a special closure. The portal receipt is dated Tuesday the 14th at 16:40. The portal's daily cutoff is 17:00.

criteria.full: Counts day one on the 3rd and day ten on the 12th.
criteria.partial: Identifies the approximate deadline without applying the exclusion rule.

criteria.full: Moves from the closed 12th past the special closure on the 13th to the open 14th.
criteria.partial: Accounts for the Sunday but overlooks the special closure.

criteria.full: Compares 16:40 to the 17:00 cutoff and reaches a conditional timely determination.
criteria.partial: States timely or late without checking the timestamp.

criteria.full: Identifies receipt, closure calendar and submission proof to preserve, and limits the conclusion to intake timing.
criteria.partial: Gives a merits conclusion or fails to identify supporting records.
